summary.text: Beth Quimby is a Republican state representative from the Caledonia-3 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since March 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Beth Quimby earned bachelor's and master's degrees in mathematics from the University of Vermont.
Before her appointment to the House, Quimby worked as a middle school math teacher and for the Vermont Agency of Education.
